name: Richard Townley

events.title: Emigration
events.description: Came in the suite of Lord Howard of Effingham, Governor of Virginia; settled at Elizabethtown, NJ.

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married (as his second wife) Elizabeth (Smith), widow of Gov. Philip Carteret.

bioAdditions: Eighth son of Nicholas Townley of Littleton (then Middlesex); member of the East New Jersey Council (1686) and of the New York Provincial Council (1692, 1697); presiding judge of the Essex County Quarter Sessions at his death in April 1711 (S1). In-law.
